observations: TJ07.1: no set. PRED-950.A1 -> PRED-1079.E2 is already recorded as states; PRED-78.E4 is a future-dated (2062) survey inside the TANG and, like PRED-1079.E2's fictional 2031 preface, is a narrated fulfilment rather than an independent forecast. Related to PRED-950.A1 by subject only.

Both already sit in the series 'Training-layer literature before the term or the training layer existed'.
